paragraphs.en: The {elderly} {residents} in {care} homes in {Britain} are being given {hens} to look after to stop them feeling {lonely} .The {initiative} has been {applauded} as a creative {cure} for elderly loneliness.It was dreamed up by a local {charity} to reduce loneliness and improve {senior} {citizens} ’well-being.It is also being used to help patients suffering from {dementia} , a serious {illness} of the mind.Staff in care homes have {reported} a reduction in the use of medicine where hens are kept.
paragraphs.cn: 住在 <u> 英国疗养 </u> 院的 <u> 老年居民 </u> 被分配了照顾 <u> 母鸡 </u> 的任务，以消除他们的 <u> 孤独 </u> 感。这一 <u> 举措 </u> 一直备受 <u> 称赞 </u> ，被认为是缓解老年人孤独的创意 <u> 疗法 </u> 。这是当地一家 <u> 慈善机构 </u> 构想出来的，意在减少 <u> 老年人 </u> 的孤独感，提高他们的幸福感。这种方法还被用于帮助 <u> 痴呆 </u> （一种严重的精神 <u> 疾病 </u> ）患者。疗养院的工作人员 <u> 报告 </u> 说，在养母鸡的地方，药物使用量有所减少。

paragraphs.en: For elderly individuals who may struggle with the physical demands of {housework} , caring for hens offers a way to engage in something meaningful.The interactions with hens are simple pleasures that can bring a smile to residents who may have {withdrawn} from social activities, {especially} when their family members live {abroad} or have busy schedules.
paragraphs.cn: 对于那些可能在应对 <u> 家务劳动 </u> 的体力要求方面存在困难的老年人来说，照顾母鸡为他们提供了一种参与有意义活动的方式。与母鸡的互动是简单的乐趣，可以给那些可能已经 <u> 脱离 </u> 社交活动的居民带来笑容， <u> 尤其 </u> 是当他们的家人住 <u> 在国外 </u> 或日程繁忙时。

paragraphs.en: “I like the project a lot.I am down there in my {wheelchair} in the morning letting the hens out and down there again at night to see that they've gone to bed.I have a {stomachache} sometimes, but looking after those hens helps me forget the {ache} .I'm not just sitting around feeling {sorry} for myself anymore.I {owe} it to this project for breaking the {cycle} .”
paragraphs.cn: “我非常喜欢这个项目。早上我坐着 <u> 轮椅 </u> 过去，把母鸡放出来，晚上再过去看看它们是不是都进窝睡觉了。我有时会 <u> 胃痛 </u> ，但照顾这些母鸡让我忘记了 <u> 疼痛 </u> 。我不再只是闲坐着自 <u> 怨 </u> 自艾。我应该 <u> 感谢 </u> 这个项目打破了这个 <u> 循环 </u> 。”

paragraphs.en: “It's good to have a different focus.People have been bringing their children in to see the hens, and residents come and sit outside to {watch} them.It brings me a sense of {pride} and {dignity} .I'm {grateful} for that.”
paragraphs.cn: “有不同的关注点是件好事。人们带着孩子来这里看母鸡，其他住户也会过来坐在外面 <u> 看 </u> 它们。这给我带来了 <u> 自豪 </u> 感和 <u> 尊严 </u> 感。我对此心存 <u> 感激 </u> 。”

paragraphs.en: There are now 700 elderly people looking after hens in 20 care homes in the {North} East, and the {welfare} center has been given {funds} and other {financial} support to {roll} it out.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，在东 <u> 北 </u> 部的20家疗养院中，有700位老人在照看母鸡，这些 <u> 福利 </u> 中心还获得了 <u> 资金 </u> 和其他 <u> 财政 </u> 支持来 <u> 推广 </u> 这项服务。

paragraphs.en: Wendy Wilson, extra care {manager} at 60 Penfold {Street} , one of the first to {embark} on the project, said:“Residents really {welcome} the idea of the project and the creative {sessions} .We are looking forward to the benefits and fun the project can bring to people {here} .”
paragraphs.cn: 温迪·威尔逊是彭福尔德 <u> 街 </u> 60号的特别护理 <u> 经理 </u> ，也是首批 <u> 开展 </u> 该项目的人之一。他说：“居民们非常 <u> 欢迎 </u> 这个项目以及各种创意 <u> 环节 </u> 的点子。我们期望 <u> 这里 </u> 的人们能从项目中受益，获得乐趣。”

paragraphs.en: Lynn Lewis, {director} of Notting Hill {Pathways} , said:“We are {glad} to be taking part in the project.It will really help connect our residents through a shared interest and creative activities.”
paragraphs.cn: 诺丁山 <u> 道路 </u> 疗养院的 <u> 负责人 </u> 林恩·刘易斯说：“我们很 <u> 高兴 </u> 能参与这个项目。它将真正帮助我们的居民通过共同的兴趣和创意活动建立联系。” 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
